description.narrative: Background: Prishtina Mall (PM or the Mall) is a super-regional mall with a GLA of ~115,000 m² located on the outskirts of Pristina, Kosovo. Construction began in 2019 (on a greenfield site); it opened in March 2023 and is currently occupied by over 200 retail units, including anchor tenants such as Intersport, H&M, Zara/Inditex, LC Waikiki, New Yorker and entertainment venues, such as HyperActive (south-Eastern Europes largest indoor amusement park). The Mall construction was financed mainly through equity investment from shareholders. IFCs financing will help settle dues to construction contractors, finance expenditures for fit-out of new tenants, fund installation of solar power and investments to improve operational efficiency, in addition to refinancing existing capital providers.

Project Outcomes: Economy-Wide: (i) direct job creation and contribution to GDP as well as indirect effects across the distribution chains; (ii) higher tax revenues for local government and; (iii) increased value added for local products. Environmental effects: By enabling energy-friendly, EDGE-certified infrastructure on Prishtina Mall, IFC expects the project to improve energy and water efficiency and reduce GHG emissions. Contribution to Market Creation: Competitiveness: Modern retail penetration of 31% in Kosovo is low compared to +80% in the developed European nations. IFC anticipates that the Project will increase competitive pressures that affect the market through expansion and subsequent increases in the offering of good quality and standardized retail infrastructure across the catchment areas.
